name: Definitive
description: Definitive Finance is a professional crypto and DeFi trading app for trading any EVM or Solana token across web, mobile, and API. It offers advanced onchain orders including Market, Limit, Stop Loss, Take Profit, DCA, Bracket, and Cross-Chain, with access to 900+ liquidity sources.

methodology.Fees: User pays 0.25% - 0.85% fee on each trade. Majors and Stables have feeless trading.
methodology.UserFees: User pays 0.25% - 0.85% fee on each trade
methodology.Revenue: Trading fees are split between Definitive and EDGE holders
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: 100% of revenue is allocated to Definitive before October 1, 2025, and 80% thereafter
methodology.HoldersRevenue: From October 1, 2025, 10% of revenue funds EDGE buybacks and 10% funds EDGE staker rewards

Fees.Trading Fees: Trading fees (0.25%-0.85% per trade) collected at Definitive fee addresses. Majors and Stables have feeless trading.

UserFees.Trading Fees: Trading fees (0.25%-0.85% per trade) paid by users. Majors and Stables have feeless trading.

Revenue.Trading Fees: Trading fees split between Definitive and EDGE holders

ProtocolRevenue.Trading Fees: 100% of trading fee revenue is allocated to Definitive before October 1, 2025, and 80% thereafter

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: 10% of trading fee revenue funds EDGE buybacks from October 1, 2025
HoldersRevenue.Staking Rewards: 10% of trading fee revenue funds EDGE staker rewards from October 1, 2025
